text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with a report on certain human resource matters which have arisen in 2021.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Established a Human Resources Committee and: a. appointed the following members to the Committee: Sandra Levy (Chair), Dennis Fotinos, Councillor Paula Fletcher and Marcie Zajdeman; b. requested the Committee to consider the report (June 24, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, and any other related human resources matters; c. requested the Committee to report back to the Board in September on the report (June 24, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, and a proposed terms of reference for the Committee; d. requested the City Clerk to provide meeting management support to the Committee. 2. Requested the Deputy City Manager, Corporate Services and the City Manager to assist the Board and the Human Resources Committee where needed. 3.
